statement: A developer system card or government AISI evaluation reports a model at the developer's highest published autonomy or AI-R&D risk tier (system cards, AISI reports; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not applicable / not met. No developer had published autonomy or AI-R&D risk tiers and no government AI safety institute existed, so the indicator's measurement apparatus did not yet exist. Developers' public commitments were high-level principles and charters.

items.summary: No developer had published a tiered autonomy or AI-R&D risk framework and no government AI safety evaluation body existed by the end of the window; the indicator's data did not yet exist.
items.detail: Searched this run; none found. The in-window frontier release (OpenAI 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30, verified via web_extract this run) listed limitations but no risk tier or system card with capability thresholds.

items.summary: A Bloc A frontier developer published model-written behavioural evaluations (including self-preservation and resource-acquisition questions) - an early form of dangerous-disposition evaluation, without capability tiers or thresholds.
